notes: Raised by issue #676 Phase 3 batch 5 — this batch completes ALL remaining Phase 3 scope. Covers: the entire stems/ subpackage (7 modules: hiphil.py broadened from 4/~21 functions to full coverage; hithpael.py, hophal.py, niphal.py, piel.py, pual.py, qal.py created from scratch — all share a StemAnalysis-based API exposing ~21 functions per module as module-level aliases, not just plain defs); verbal_syntax/verb_forms.py (created from scratch, 11 functions); the entire intertextuality/ subpackage (parallel.py, quotation_align.py, quotations.py — all created from scratch, 10 functions); and discourse/genre_compare.py (broadened) + speaker.py (created from scratch) — completing discourse/ too. Two real bugs found and fixed: (1) hophal.py's and qal.py's *_report() functions both crashed with KeyError('niphal_count') — a copy-paste bug in the dominant-roots Markdown table that hardcoded niphal's count-column name instead of each module's own (hophal_count/qal_count) — verified broken in production, now fixed and regression-tested. (2) verbal_syntax/verb_forms.py's GENRE_SETS dict used SBL-style book abbreviations ('Exod', '1Sam', 'Eze', etc.) that don't match this corpus's real book_id values ('Exo', '1Sa', 'Ezk') — 17 of 33 book codes were wrong, so aspect_comparison(GENRE_SETS['narrative']) silently returned near-zero results; fixed to use real codes, regression-tested. Also caught and fixed a test-authoring mistake mid-batch: the stems/ *_report() functions generate their embedded charts internally via each module's shared StemAnalysis instance's real _chart_dir — report tests must monkeypatch that too, not just pass output_dir, or they silently write real PNGs into the tracked output/ tree (caught before committing; verified output/ stays clean). unit_min_percent measured in an isolated venv matching CI's exact package list AND Python version (3.12, not the system default), with data/processed/ temporarily moved aside to match CI's fresh checkout (CI never builds it) — see the gotchas documented in docs/policies/test-coverage.md. Unchanged at 12.50% this batch since all new tests are integration-marked. full_min_percent measured in the regular fully-provisioned dev venv, raised 61.74% -> 66.93%. This completes issue #676 Phase 3 in full. Update only via `scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same PR that earns the increase — see docs/policies/test-coverage.md.
